We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied 20810 to target, got two products: product1 = "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and product2 = "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". That's from template 20810.

Now need to apply template 2895 to product1 (since order). We checked matching true, applied, got product: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". So product1 transformed.

Now apply template 1914397 to that product, got two products: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". So we have split into two fragments.

Now next template 1914398 must be applied to one of these fragments (or both?) The order is fixed, but we need to apply each template sequentially to appropriate intermediate(s) to eventually reach starting materials (buyable). We need at least 6 reactions total, we have 3 so far. Need to apply 1914398, 1914399, 74054.

We need to check applicability of 1914398 to each fragment. We tried on "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1" and got False. Maybe apply to the other fragment "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". Let's test.
